type NumericApi = Pick<typeof B, "sparseGraph" | "importSparseGraph" | "exportSparseGraph" | "validateSparseGraph">;
type Work = { state: unknown; action: () => unknown };
type Guard = <T>(label: string, inputs: unknown, call: () => T) => T;
type StageProof = { label: string; before: string; after: string; referenceCount: number; referencesStable: boolean; returned: boolean; errorReference: 0 | null };
type Expected = { kind: "value" } | { kind: "refusal"; code: string; message?: string };
type ProposedCase = {
  id: string; inputHash: string; config: unknown; expected: Expected; oracle: string;
  make: (side: Side, guard: Guard) => Work;
};
const SEED = "numeric-context-qualification-v1", H = "a".repeat(64);
const id = (i: number): string => `${H}:0x${(16 + i * 16).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;
const sha = (bytes: string | Uint8Array): string => createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
type Writer = ReturnType<typeof evidenceWriter>;

// Root-supplied inspected-run provenance ONLY. No inspector transport, native
// compiler API or SourceMap-V3 mappings decoder exists in this test consumer.
type ByteRef = { path: string; bytes: number; sha256: string };
type PointRange = { generatedLine: number; firstColumn: number; lastColumn: number; sourceLine: number; sourceColumn: number };
type NativeEmitterBindingV2 = {
  version: "native-emitter-binding-v3"; runId: string; inspected: true;
  producerContract: "owned-bun-webkit-native-v2"; catalogPath: string;
  runnerByteRef: ByteRef; argvDigest: string; configByteRef: ByteRef; envDigest: string; testSourceSha256: string;
  writerSourceSha256: string; nativeProofSourceSha256: string;
};
type NativeEmitterSealV1 = {
  version: "numeric-native-emitter-seal-v1"; runId: string; invocationBindingSha256: string; catalogue: ByteRef;
};
type NativeEmitterInvocation = {
  catalogPath: string; sealPath: string; bindingPath: string; runId: string; expectedBindingSha256: string;
};
type NativeEmitterModuleV1 = {
  side: Side | "test"; sourceByteRef: ByteRef; scriptId: string; scriptURL: string;
  emittedByteRef: ByteRef; nativeSourceMapByteRef: ByteRef; nativeMapSource: string; pointRanges: PointRange[];
};
type NativeEmitterCatalogV2 = {
  version: "native-emitter-catalog-v3"; runId: string; inspected: true;
  producerContract: "owned-bun-webkit-native-v2"; coordinateConvention: "native-glb-utf16-1-based";
  runnerByteRef: ByteRef; argvDigest: string; configByteRef: ByteRef; envDigest: string; modules: NativeEmitterModuleV1[];
  nativeMapSites: NativeMapSite[]; dispatchSource: DispatchSource;
};
type EmittedModule = NativeEmitterModuleV1 & { sourceLines: string[]; emittedLines: string[] };
type NativeCatalog = { binding: NativeEmitterBindingV2; catalog: NativeEmitterCatalogV2; dispatchAuthority: DispatchAuthority;
  bySourceURL: Map<string, EmittedModule>; inputBytes: number; cachedBytes: (ref: ByteRef) => Buffer };
const HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, MODULE_CAP = 1024 * 1024, CATALOG_CAP = 16 * 1024 * 1024, PROVENANCE_CAP = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const NATIVE_BUN_SHA256 = "15277c59ccd6c6c20f8dc9716c2b59c1776320d606b6a8658f70be8799519ca4";
function closed(value: unknown, keys: readonly string[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  insist(value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) && Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype, "closed JSON object required");
  const r = value as Record<string, unknown>, actual = Reflect.ownKeys(r);
  insist(actual.length === keys.length && actual.every(k => typeof k === "string" && keys.includes(k)), "unknown/missing catalogue property"); return r;
}
function natural(value: unknown, minimum = 1): value is number {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && !Object.is(value, -0) && value >= minimum;
}
function byteRef(value: unknown): ByteRef {
  const r = closed(value, ["path", "bytes", "sha256"]);
  insist(typeof r.path === "string" && isAbsolute(r.path) && r.path === resolve(r.path) && natural(r.bytes, 0) && typeof r.sha256 === "string" && HEX.test(r.sha256), "invalid byte reference");
  return r as ByteRef;
}
function equalRef(a: ByteRef, b: ByteRef): boolean { return a.path === b.path && a.bytes === b.bytes && a.sha256 === b.sha256; }
function nativeInlineProof(sourceText: string, emittedText: string, mapBytes: Buffer, mapSource: string, scriptURL: string): void {
  const lines = emittedText.split(/\r?\n/), mapLines = lines.filter(line => line.startsWith("//# sourceMappingURL=")), urlLines = lines.filter(line => line.startsWith("//# sourceURL="));
  insist(mapLines.length === 1 && urlLines.length === 1 && urlLines[0] === `//# sourceURL=${scriptURL}`, "native inline map/script URL identity");
  const encoded = /^\/\/# sourceMappingURL=data:application\/json;base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2})$/.exec(mapLines[0]!);
  insist(encoded !== null, "unsupported native map URL");
  const inline = Buffer.from(encoded[1]!, "base64");
  insist(inline.toString("base64") === encoded[1] && inline.equals(mapBytes), "native map bytes differ from actual loaded buffer");
  const nativeMap = closed(JSON.parse(mapBytes.toString("utf8")) as unknown, ["version", "sources", "sourcesContent", "mappings", "names"]);
  insist(nativeMap.version === 3 && Array.isArray(nativeMap.sources) && nativeMap.sources.length === 1 && nativeMap.sources[0] === mapSource
    && Array.isArray(nativeMap.sourcesContent) && nativeMap.sourcesContent.length === 1 && nativeMap.sourcesContent[0] === sourceText
    && typeof nativeMap.mappings === "string" && Array.isArray(nativeMap.names) && nativeMap.names.every(name => typeof name === "string"), "native map/source content mismatch");
}
function nativeRange(module: EmittedModule, line: number, column: number, sourceLine: number, sourceColumn: number): PointRange {
  insist(natural(line) && natural(column) && natural(sourceLine) && natural(sourceColumn), "invalid native tuple");
  const row = module.pointRanges.find(r => r.generatedLine === line && r.firstColumn <= column && column <= r.lastColumn);
  insist(row !== undefined && row.sourceLine === sourceLine && row.sourceColumn === sourceColumn, "native original tuple has no exact top-source GLB range"); return row;
}
function catalogueVersion(value: unknown): void { insist(value === "native-emitter-catalog-v3", "unsupported native catalogue version"); }
function invocationInputs(catalogPath: unknown, bindingPath: unknown, runId: unknown, sealPath: unknown,
  expectedBindingSha256: unknown, legacyCatalogSha256: unknown, legacyBindingSha256: unknown): NativeEmitterInvocation {
  insist(legacyCatalogSha256 === undefined && legacyBindingSha256 === undefined, "legacy emitter digest ENV is unsupported");
  insist(typeof catalogPath === "string" && isAbsolute(catalogPath) && typeof bindingPath === "string" && isAbsolute(bindingPath)
    && typeof runId === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$/.test(runId)
    && typeof sealPath === "string" && isAbsolute(sealPath) && typeof expectedBindingSha256 === "string" && HEX.test(expectedBindingSha256), "missing closed emitter invocation inputs");
  return { catalogPath, bindingPath, runId, sealPath, expectedBindingSha256 };
}
function emitterSeal(value: unknown, invocation: NativeEmitterInvocation): NativeEmitterSealV1 {
  const r = closed(value, ["version", "runId", "invocationBindingSha256", "catalogue"]), catalogue = byteRef(r.catalogue);
  insist(r.version === "numeric-native-emitter-seal-v1" && r.runId === invocation.runId
    && r.invocationBindingSha256 === invocation.expectedBindingSha256 && catalogue.path === invocation.catalogPath
    && catalogue.bytes > 0 && catalogue.bytes <= CATALOG_CAP, "emitter seal invocation/path/size mismatch");
  return { version: "numeric-native-emitter-seal-v1", runId: invocation.runId,
    invocationBindingSha256: invocation.expectedBindingSha256, catalogue };
}
function sealReady(exists: boolean, now: number, deadline: number): boolean {
  insist(Number.isFinite(now) && Number.isFinite(deadline) && now <= deadline, "10 s emitter SEAL barrier expired"); return exists;
}
function sealedBytes(seal: NativeEmitterSealV1, binding: Buffer, catalogue: Buffer): void {
  insist(sha(binding) === seal.invocationBindingSha256 && catalogue.length === seal.catalogue.bytes
    && sha(catalogue) === seal.catalogue.sha256, "sealed RAW binding/catalogue bytes mismatch");
}
function publicationControls(invocation: NativeEmitterInvocation): void {
  // Publication-component data only: not native emit or issuer-authentication evidence.
  const binding = Buffer.from("synthetic prebound binding"), catalogue = Buffer.from("synthetic catalogue"), expected = sha(binding);
  const inputs = { ...invocation, expectedBindingSha256: expected };
  const raw: NativeEmitterSealV1 = { version: "numeric-native-emitter-seal-v1", runId: inputs.runId,
    invocationBindingSha256: expected, catalogue: { path: inputs.catalogPath, bytes: catalogue.length, sha256: sha(catalogue) } };
  const checked = emitterSeal(raw, inputs); sealedBytes(checked, binding, catalogue);
  expect(() => emitterSeal({ ...raw, runId: `${raw.runId}_other` }, inputs)).toThrow();
  expect(() => emitterSeal({ ...raw, invocationBindingSha256: "0".repeat(64) }, inputs)).toThrow();
  expect(() => emitterSeal({ ...raw, catalogue: { ...raw.catalogue, path: resolve(inputs.catalogPath, "..", "wrong-catalogue.json") } }, inputs)).toThrow();
  expect(() => emitterSeal({ version: raw.version, runId: raw.runId, catalogue: raw.catalogue }, inputs)).toThrow();
  expect(() => emitterSeal({ ...raw, unknown: true }, inputs)).toThrow();
  expect(() => sealedBytes({ ...checked, catalogue: { ...checked.catalogue, sha256: "0".repeat(64) } }, binding, catalogue)).toThrow();
  expect(() => sealedBytes(checked, Buffer.from("wrong binding"), catalogue)).toThrow();
  expect(() => sealedBytes(checked, binding, catalogue.subarray(0, catalogue.length - 1))).toThrow();
  expect(() => emitterSeal(JSON.parse("{") as unknown, inputs)).toThrow();
  insist(!sealReady(false, 0, 10000) && sealReady(true, 9999, 10000), "SEAL missing/readiness control");
  expect(() => sealReady(false, 10001, 10000)).toThrow(); expect(() => sealReady(true, 10001, 10000)).toThrow();
  for (const legacy of ["", "0".repeat(64)]) {
    expect(() => invocationInputs(inputs.catalogPath, inputs.bindingPath, inputs.runId, inputs.sealPath, expected, legacy, undefined)).toThrow();
    expect(() => invocationInputs(inputs.catalogPath, inputs.bindingPath, inputs.runId, inputs.sealPath, expected, undefined, legacy)).toThrow();
  }
  // The final name stays absent while an incomplete temporary publication exists.
  // chmod/close precede the root's atomic absent-name rename; child has no rename/write API here.
  const names = new Map<string, Buffer>(); names.set("temporary-WX", Buffer.from("{"));
  insist(!sealReady(names.has("final-SEAL"), 1, 10000), "partial temporary SEAL cannot release barrier");
  names.set("temporary-WX", Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw))); const closedReadonly = names.get("temporary-WX")!;
  names.delete("temporary-WX"); names.set("final-SEAL", closedReadonly);
  insist(sealReady(names.has("final-SEAL"), 2, 10000), "atomic final-name publication control");
  emitterSeal(JSON.parse(names.get("final-SEAL")!.toString("utf8")) as unknown, inputs);
}
function ownedReader(root: string) {
  const canonical = realpathSync(root), cache = new Map<string, Buffer>(); let total = 0;
  const inside = (path: string): void => {
    const actual = realpathSync(path), rel = relative(canonical, actual);
    insist(rel.length > 0 && !isAbsolute(rel) && rel !== ".." && !rel.startsWith(`..\\`) && !rel.startsWith("../"), "foreign provenance read");
    const caseRel = relative(join(canonical, "numeric-context-qualification-v3"), actual);
    insist(isAbsolute(caseRel) || caseRel === ".." || caseRel.startsWith(`..\\`) || caseRel.startsWith("../"), "parent provenance must not occupy the fresh case child");
  };
  const read = (path: string, cap: number): Buffer => {
    insist(isAbsolute(path) && path === resolve(path), "noncanonical provenance path"); inside(path);
    const old = cache.get(path); if (old) { insist(old.length <= cap, "cached provenance cap"); return old; }
    const stat = lstatSync(path);
    insist(stat.isFile() && !stat.isSymbolicLink() && (stat.mode & 0o222) === 0 && natural(stat.size, 0) && stat.size <= cap, "unsealed/oversize provenance file");
    insist(total + stat.size <= PROVENANCE_CAP, "64 MiB provenance cap");
    const bytes = readFileSync(path); insist(bytes.length === stat.size, "provenance read race");
    total += bytes.length; cache.set(path, bytes); return bytes;
  };
  const ref = (r: ByteRef, cap = MODULE_CAP): Buffer => { const bytes = read(r.path, cap); insist(bytes.length === r.bytes && sha(bytes) === r.sha256, "byte reference mismatch"); return bytes; };
  const cached = (r: ByteRef): Buffer => { const bytes = cache.get(r.path); insist(bytes !== undefined && bytes.length === r.bytes && sha(bytes) === r.sha256, "unapproved cached provenance reference"); return Buffer.from(bytes); };
  return { read, ref, cached, get total() { return total; } };
}
async function nativeCatalog(root: string): Promise<NativeCatalog> {
  // All ENV values are fixed before spawn. The only preknown digest is the
  // independent RAW binding digest; a post-start catalogue digest arrives in SEAL.
  const invocation = invocationInputs(process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_CATALOG, process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_BINDING,
    process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_RUN_ID, process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_SEAL,
    process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_EXPECTED_BINDING_SHA256, process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_CATALOG_SHA256,
    process.env.PARENT_NATIVE_EMITTER_BINDING_SHA256);
  const { catalogPath, bindingPath, runId, sealPath, expectedBindingSha256 } = invocation;
  publicationControls(invocation);
  const deadline = performance.now() + 10000;
  while (!sealReady(existsSync(sealPath), performance.now(), deadline)) {
    await new Promise<void>(done => setTimeout(done, 10));
  }
  const reader = ownedReader(root), sealBytes = reader.read(sealPath, MODULE_CAP);
  const seal = emitterSeal(JSON.parse(sealBytes.toString("utf8")) as unknown, invocation);
  const bindBytes = reader.read(bindingPath, MODULE_CAP), catBytes = reader.ref(seal.catalogue, CATALOG_CAP);
  insist(sha(bindBytes) === expectedBindingSha256, "independent prebound RAW binding mismatch");
  sealedBytes(seal, bindBytes, catBytes);
  const b = closed(JSON.parse(bindBytes.toString("utf8")) as unknown, ["version", "runId", "inspected", "producerContract", "catalogPath", "runnerByteRef", "argvDigest", "configByteRef", "envDigest", "testSourceSha256", "writerSourceSha256", "nativeProofSourceSha256"]);
  insist(b.version === "native-emitter-binding-v3" && b.runId === runId && b.inspected === true && b.producerContract === "owned-bun-webkit-native-v2"
    && b.catalogPath === catalogPath && typeof b.argvDigest === "string" && HEX.test(b.argvDigest) && typeof b.envDigest === "string" && HEX.test(b.envDigest)
    && typeof b.testSourceSha256 === "string" && HEX.test(b.testSourceSha256)
    && typeof b.writerSourceSha256 === "string" && HEX.test(b.writerSourceSha256)
    && typeof b.nativeProofSourceSha256 === "string" && HEX.test(b.nativeProofSourceSha256), "invalid independent invocation binding");
  const runner = byteRef(b.runnerByteRef), config = byteRef(b.configByteRef);
  insist(runner.sha256 === NATIVE_BUN_SHA256 && runner.bytes === 86096984 && runner.path === resolve(process.execPath), "wrong pinned runner binding");
  reader.ref(config); // Runner executable stamp is metadata checked by root, not an 86 MiB foreign read.
  const c = closed(JSON.parse(catBytes.toString("utf8")) as unknown, ["version", "runId", "inspected", "producerContract", "coordinateConvention", "runnerByteRef", "argvDigest", "configByteRef", "envDigest", "modules", "nativeMapSites", "dispatchSource"]);
  catalogueVersion(c.version);
  insist(c.version === "native-emitter-catalog-v3" && c.runId === runId && c.inspected === true && c.producerContract === b.producerContract
    && c.coordinateConvention === "native-glb-utf16-1-based" && c.argvDigest === b.argvDigest && c.envDigest === b.envDigest
    && equalRef(byteRef(c.runnerByteRef), runner) && equalRef(byteRef(c.configByteRef), config) && Array.isArray(c.modules), "wrong inspected-run catalogue binding");
  const expected = new Map<string, { side: Side | "test"; sha256: string }>();
  for (const side of ["baseline", "candidate"] as const) for (const [file, hash] of Object.entries(productPins[side])) expected.set(sourceFile(side, file), { side, sha256: hash });
  for (const side of ["baseline", "candidate"] as const) {
    expected.set(sourceFile(side, "validation.ts"), { side, sha256: "9f15f63c8c5b7ca39a3729be59b866f68f7ff6dc1f15655b0cb569d1498acb50" });
    expected.set(sourceFile(side, "re-policy.ts"), { side, sha256: "c3714c3120d3e8f87a044ef6857ca40c41900a6c74647d1bfdc6205371dfc365" });
  }
  expected.set(resolve(import.meta.path), { side: "test", sha256: b.testSourceSha256 });
  expected.set(resolve(import.meta.dir, "numeric-evidence-writer.ts"), { side: "test", sha256: b.writerSourceSha256 });
  expected.set(resolve(import.meta.dir, "../native/numeric-native-proof.ts"), { side: "test", sha256: b.nativeProofSourceSha256 });
  const modules: unknown[] = c.modules;
  insist(modules.length === expected.size, "catalogue must contain the exact declared runtime closure, including private seams and support");
  const bySourceURL = new Map<string, EmittedModule>(), scripts = new Set<string>();
  for (const value of modules) {
    const m = closed(value, ["side", "sourceByteRef", "scriptId", "scriptURL", "emittedByteRef", "nativeSourceMapByteRef", "nativeMapSource", "pointRanges"]);
    const source = byteRef(m.sourceByteRef), emitted = byteRef(m.emittedByteRef), map = byteRef(m.nativeSourceMapByteRef), wanted = expected.get(source.path);
    insist(source.bytes + emitted.bytes + map.bytes <= MODULE_CAP, "1 MiB aggregate native module cap");
    insist(wanted !== undefined && m.side === wanted.side && source.sha256 === wanted.sha256 && m.scriptURL === source.path
      && typeof m.scriptId === "string" && m.scriptId.length > 0 && m.scriptId.length <= 128 && !scripts.has(m.scriptId)
      && typeof m.nativeMapSource === "string" && m.nativeMapSource.length > 0 && Array.isArray(m.pointRanges) && !bySourceURL.has(source.path), "wrong/duplicate native module identity");
    scripts.add(m.scriptId);
    const sourceBytes = reader.ref(source), emittedBytes = reader.ref(emitted), mapBytes = reader.ref(map);
    const sourceText = sourceBytes.toString("utf8"), emittedText = emittedBytes.toString("utf8"), sourceLines = sourceText.split(/\r?\n/), emittedLines = emittedText.split(/\r?\n/);
    nativeInlineProof(sourceText, emittedText, mapBytes, m.nativeMapSource, source.path);
    let previous: PointRange | undefined; const ranges: PointRange[] = [];
    for (const value of m.pointRanges as unknown[]) {
      const r = closed(value, ["generatedLine", "firstColumn", "lastColumn", "sourceLine", "sourceColumn"]);
      insist(natural(r.generatedLine) && r.generatedLine <= emittedLines.length && natural(r.firstColumn) && natural(r.lastColumn)
        && r.firstColumn <= r.lastColumn && r.lastColumn <= emittedLines[r.generatedLine - 1]!.length + 1
        && natural(r.sourceLine) && r.sourceLine <= sourceLines.length && natural(r.sourceColumn) && r.sourceColumn <= sourceLines[r.sourceLine - 1]!.length + 1, "invalid UTF16 point range");
      const row = r as PointRange;
      insist(previous === undefined || row.generatedLine > previous.generatedLine || row.generatedLine === previous.generatedLine && row.firstColumn > previous.lastColumn, "unordered/overlapping native point ranges");
      ranges.push(row); previous = row;
    }
    insist(ranges.length > 0, "missing native point ranges");
    bySourceURL.set(source.path, { side: wanted.side, sourceByteRef: source, scriptId: m.scriptId, scriptURL: source.path,
      emittedByteRef: emitted, nativeSourceMapByteRef: map, nativeMapSource: m.nativeMapSource, pointRanges: ranges, sourceLines, emittedLines });
  }
  insist(Array.isArray(c.nativeMapSites) && c.nativeMapSites.length === 4, "exact four scientific AST map sites required");
  const siteKeys = new Set<string>();
  for (const raw of c.nativeMapSites as unknown[]) {
    const site = closed(raw, ["side", "site", "file", "sourceSha256", "astToolSha256", "callback", "caller", "functionName", "receiver"]);
    insist((site.side === "baseline" || site.side === "candidate") && (site.site === "scale" || site.site === "ppr"), "unknown scientific native map site");
    const file = sourceFile(site.side, "cluster.ts"), key = `${site.side}/${site.site}`;
    const callback = closed(site.callback, ["line", "column"]), caller = closed(site.caller, ["line", "column"]);
    const scale = site.site === "scale", baseline = site.side === "baseline";
    insist(!siteKeys.has(key) && site.file === file && site.sourceSha256 === productPins[site.side]["cluster.ts"] && site.astToolSha256 === PINNED_AST_TOOL_SHA
      && callback.line === (scale ? baseline ? 181 : 106 : baseline ? 513 : 296) && callback.column === (scale ? 18 : 44)
      && caller.line === (scale ? baseline ? 179 : 104 : baseline ? 512 : 295) && caller.column === (scale ? 28 : 24)
      && site.functionName === (scale ? "scaledGraph" : "personalizedPageRankUnchecked") && site.receiver === (scale ? "summands(g)" : "row"), "native AST site/pin/point mismatch");
    siteKeys.add(key);
  }
  const testModule = bySourceURL.get(resolve(import.meta.path))!;
  const dispatchSource = checkDispatchSource(c.dispatchSource, reader.ref(testModule.sourceByteRef).toString("utf8"), testModule.sourceByteRef.path);
  insist(dispatchSource.sourceRevision === "owned-dispatch-v1", "historical source dispatch is offline data only");
  const dispatchAuthority: DispatchAuthority = { runId, bindingSha256: sha(bindBytes), catalogueSha256: sha(catBytes),
    bindingTestSha256: b.testSourceSha256 as string, catalogueTestSha256: testModule.sourceByteRef.sha256, source: dispatchSource };
  return { binding: b as NativeEmitterBindingV2, catalog: c as NativeEmitterCatalogV2, dispatchAuthority, bySourceURL, inputBytes: reader.total, cachedBytes: reader.cached };
}

// Fixture order is literally cluster.test.ts:357. The 17th packet fixture,
// ff8-identity-rename, remains in the unchanged original test, not the 16x4 matrix.
const F = "1c8c2893ed9b6bb1f299e0f3878518fbe1df27db1df21c5043699d1728d385bb";
const fixturePins = [
  ["communities-obvious", "fd452804a2c098d68ce4ed18f6dbf5c678af27b221e3f9276005a20c979073e4", `${F}:0x2000`],
  ["components-disconnected", "71079dd202b0bbd50a337f0d1466b1bfb87c68396fe8f51e29ff2823ecb20242", `${F}:0x1000`],
  ["hubs-utilities", "1e38704f35b7325d9277a7fa6dc13aa0c25d0cdc62ce7b407ed4bdbfaf8893aa", `${F}:0x1000`],
  ["cycles-recursion", "e787e99c859f77ea1be54273f163b6c65320382ba7cd5417cf3ca2e2c38091a9", `${F}:0x5100`],
  ["indirect-uncertain", "1e3830d78b077e3f7d09f6effcf325cf360ebcf1c2cddd1ba54039319f379f75", `${F}:0x7000`],
  ["isolates", "658b438153ce8ecac1719457792334a3043efe09c1df1f264e511749e31dd1af", `${F}:0x6000`],
  ["bridges-rare", "69278ee8e28390b623f525774e8fe036231873934fb30ed0e98a2c33353105c4", `${F}:0x2000`],
  ["shared-data", "09b2ce91c3d4c2d0499a0e6d376a8ed534ac12c3d44688084f699d9d77dc0eb8", `${F}:0x8000`],
  ["ff8-chunks-tails", "dcaf79b23970660ec930f56d233b75580a28f5f45f5717488ba0569b31567501", `${F}:0xC000`],
  ["ff8-imports-thunks", "010857160b1eec0509bf9ed3d182d2018b2ea2597174137a5427e2ff90639d41", `${F}:0xB000`],
  ["ff8-data-callback-not-call", "3982efd1696451724029483da7193fbf74eb0064e3bc4aafb0e01862fbdf94d4", `${F}:0xA000`],
  ["ff8-idb-pe-quarantine", "35f019b2caf28aa3346507d3309baaa837df27c987d234f8726ebfcf28db7dd2", "064d466b5fe2ba901fd44abf19f37c0fd6a2db40aabd95c9e5959195b6589570:0x60860"],
  ["ff8-multi-module", "513561269a3ae03630a823365bcc11ef259651f2d4fae5cdf0a7d64ca26ff794", `${F}:0x1000`],
  ["ff8-self-loop", "0fe3ac5b2d981992df569db199a9c9d95001ea54950c46ca97053f4edff0127f", `${F}:0x9000`],
  ["ff8-unknown-metrics", "261c31eb7130a916d6525ad5820ba28d2c35d8d8e7c549a65131ee5c0d89079c", `${F}:0xF000`],
  ["ff8-coverage-partial-tails", "b5f5ace60d6e037bb1021177e08df9e2aedff2ac96fbc80ce0c5b96163dbd3c9", `${F}:0xD000`],
] as const;
function loadFixture(name: string, hash: string): B.ClusterInput {
  const bytes = readFileSync(resolve(import.meta.dir, "../../baseline/tools/ff8-harness/test/fixtures/graph", name, "content.json"));
  insist(sha(bytes) === hash, `fixture pin ${name}`);
  // Packet JSON is independently parsed for EVERY branch/case; no cross-branch object.
  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8")); return parsed as B.ClusterInput;
}
function synthetic(n: number, pairs: Array<[number, number]>): B.ClusterInput {
  return {
    snapshotId: `synthetic:${n}`, normalizedFingerprint: BF({ n, pairs }),
    nodes: Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({ id: id(i), moduleSha256: H, rva: id(i).split(":")[1]!,
      functionClass: "internal", status: "observed", semanticMaturity: "structural",
      sizeBytes: { known: true, value: 16 }, instructionCount: { known: true, value: 4 } })),
    edges: pairs.map(([a, b], i) => ({ sourceId: id(a), destinationId: id(b), kind: "direct_call", status: "observed",
      confidence: "high", retiredInRevision: null, sites: [{ siteRva: `0x${(i + 1).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`, xrefType: "code" }] })),
    objects: [], unresolved: [], capabilities: [], coverage: { status: "complete", uncoveredReason: null },
  };
}
function matrixConfig(algorithm: B.ClusterConfig["algorithm"], firstId: string | undefined): B.ClusterConfig {
  return { algorithm, maxCommunitySize: 128, weights: {}, seedIds: algorithm === "ppr" && firstId !== undefined ? [firstId] : [],
    seedCapabilityIds: [], ppr: {}, leiden: { seed: SEED } };
}
const ok: Expected = { kind: "value" };
const numericNo: Expected = { kind: "refusal", code: "unsupported-numeric" };
function matrixCases(): ProposedCase[] {
  const cases: ProposedCase[] = [];
  for (const [name, hash, firstId] of fixturePins) for (const algorithm of ["historical-cc", "hub-baseline", "leiden", "ppr"] as const) {
    const config = matrixConfig(algorithm, firstId);
    const stem = `fixture/${name}/${algorithm}`;
    cases.push({ id: `${stem}/cluster`, inputHash: hash, config, expected: ok, oracle: "cluster.test.ts:354-367 + explicit PPR seed",
      make: (side, guard) => {
        const api = side === "baseline" ? B : C, input = loadFixture(name, hash), cfg = structuredClone(config);
        const projected = guard("matrix/projectStructural", { input }, () => api.projectStructural(input));
        insist(projected.graph.ids[0] === firstId, `first projected admissible seed ${stem}`);
        return { state: { input, cfg, projected }, action: () => guard("matrix/clusterGraph", { input, cfg }, () => api.clusterGraph(input, cfg)) };
      } });
    for (const mode of ["raw", "provided-affinity"] as const) cases.push({ id: `${stem}/groups/${mode}`, inputHash: hash,
      config: { cluster: config, group: {}, adjacency: mode }, expected: ok, oracle: "cluster.test.ts:354-367; independent branch partition/projection",
      make: (side, guard) => {
        const api = side === "baseline" ? B : C, build = side === "baseline" ? BG : CG;
        const input = loadFixture(name, hash), cfg = structuredClone(config);
        const result = guard("matrix/groups/clusterGraph", { input, cfg }, () => api.clusterGraph(input, cfg));
        insist(result.projection.graph.ids[0] === firstId, `first projected admissible seed ${stem}`);
        const options = mode === "raw" ? {} : { graph: result.projection.graph, hubIds: result.metrics.hubIds };
        const overrides = {};
        return { state: { input, cfg, result, options, overrides }, action: () => guard("matrix/buildInvestigationGroups", { input, partition: result.partition, overrides, options }, () => build(input, result.partition, overrides, options)) };
      } });
  }
  return cases;
}

// Pins and literal moved spans from candidate/MANIFEST.json. These classify
// technical origin evidence; they NEVER replace the scientific comparison.
const productPins: Record<Side, Record<string, string>> = {
  baseline: { "cluster.ts": "c34d02cb1d32f9ccf336c59f1ce4dc421504bb638d9a3c3e94fc2bfe0ffe9303", "investigation-groups.ts": "cf3201b0e6d6ae5d67afc628a8a59e7ecda2a830a07049a1923001033be38525" },

};
type Span = readonly [file: string, first: number, last: number, baselineFile: string, baselineFirst: number];
const moved: readonly Span[] = [
  ["sparse-graph-codecs.ts", 12, 12, "cluster.ts", 50], ["sparse-graph-codecs.ts", 16, 21, "cluster.ts", 54],

function sourceFile(side: Side, file: string): string {
  return resolve(import.meta.dir, `../../${side}/tools/ff8-harness/src`, file);
}
type SourceOrigin = {
  raw: string; rawLocation: string; file: string; line: number; column: number; sourceHash: string; sourceLine: string;
  kind: "product" | "test" | "prepare-wrapper"; classification: string;
  mappedFile: string | null; mappedLine: number | null; mappedColumn: number | null; mappedSourceHash: string | null;
};
type RuntimeOrigin = {
  raw: string; rawLocation: "native:1:11"; kind: "native-runtime"; classification: string;
  file: null; line: null; column: null; sourceHash: null; sourceLine: null;
  mappedFile: null; mappedLine: null; mappedColumn: null; mappedSourceHash: null;
  nativeProof?: FiniteNativeMapProof;
};
type Origin = SourceOrigin | RuntimeOrigin;
function origins(stack: string, error: Error, side: Side, sites: readonly NativeMapSite[]): Origin[] {
  const lines = stack.split(/\r?\n/);
  insist(lines.shift() === `${error.name}: ${error.message}`, "unclassified stack header");
  insist(lines.length > 0, "missing error source frames");
  const frames = lines.map<Origin>(raw => {
    // The one runtime token has NO source coordinates. All other unknown native,
    // eval/async/foreign frames remain fatal; nothing is stripped from the chain.
    if (raw === "    at map (native:1:11)") return { raw, rawLocation: "native:1:11", kind: "native-runtime",
      classification: "runtime token awaiting exact same-run AST neighbor proof", file: null, line: null, column: null,
      sourceHash: null, sourceLine: null, mappedFile: null, mappedLine: null, mappedColumn: null, mappedSourceHash: null };
    const match = /^\s*at (?:[^()]+? \()?(.+):(\d+):(\d+)\)?$/.exec(raw);
    insist(match !== null, `unavailable origin mapping: ${raw}`);
    const location = match[1]!, file = resolve(location.startsWith("file:") ? fileURLToPath(location) : location);
    const line = Number(match[2]), column = Number(match[3]);
    insist(Number.isSafeInteger(line) && Number.isSafeInteger(column), "noninteger source coordinates");
    const ownTest = file === resolve(import.meta.path);
    const leaf = Object.keys(productPins[side]).find(name => sourceFile(side, name) === file);
    insist(ownTest || leaf !== undefined, "source frame outside closed pinned tree; do not read foreign origin");
    const bytes = readFileSync(file), text = bytes.toString("utf8").split(/\r?\n/), sourceHash = sha(bytes);
    insist(line >= 1 && line <= text.length && column >= 1 && column <= text[line - 1]!.length + 1, "source coordinates outside pinned text");
    const sourceLine = text[line - 1]!;
    if (ownTest) return { raw, rawLocation: location, file, line, column, sourceHash, sourceLine, kind: "test",
      mappedFile: file, mappedLine: line, mappedColumn: column, mappedSourceHash: sourceHash,
      classification: "exact common authored-test file/hash/line/column; no generic frame token" };
    insist(leaf !== undefined && sourceHash === productPins[side][leaf], "source frame outside pinned product tree");
    if (side === "baseline") return { raw, rawLocation: location, file, line, column, sourceHash, sourceLine, kind: "product",
      mappedFile: file, mappedLine: line, mappedColumn: column, mappedSourceHash: sourceHash,
      classification: `baseline:${leaf}:${line}:${column}` };
    const span = moved.find(([name, first, last]) => name === leaf && line >= first && line <= last);
    if (span) {
      const baselineLine = span[4] + line - span[1], originalBytes = readFileSync(sourceFile("baseline", span[3]));
      insist(sha(originalBytes) === productPins.baseline[span[3]], "baseline origin pin drift");
      const original = originalBytes.toString("utf8").split(/\r?\n/);
      const exportPrefix = leaf === "sparse-graph-codecs.ts" && [51, 52, 65, 68, 71, 74, 78, 88].includes(line)
        || leaf === "group-context-codecs.ts" && line === 56;
      insist(text[line - 1] === (exportPrefix ? `export ${original[baselineLine - 1]}` : original[baselineLine - 1]), "moved source line differs beyond declared linkage prefix");
      const mappedColumn = column - (exportPrefix ? 7 : 0);
      insist(mappedColumn >= 1 && mappedColumn <= original[baselineLine - 1]!.length + 1, "unjustifiable export-prefix/source column");
      return { raw, rawLocation: location, file, line, column, sourceHash, sourceLine, kind: "product",
        mappedFile: sourceFile("baseline", span[3]), mappedLine: baselineLine, mappedColumn,
        mappedSourceHash: sha(originalBytes), classification: exportPrefix ? "proved exact 7-character export prefix plus moved line" : "literal moved source line and unchanged column" };
    }
    // Only this callsite can add a frame in the 226 expected refusals. It has
    // NO invented baseline coordinate; pair reconciliation must justify it.
    if (leaf === "investigation-groups.ts" && line === 49)
      return { raw, rawLocation: location, file, line, column, sourceHash, sourceLine, kind: "prepare-wrapper",
        mappedFile: null, mappedLine: null, mappedColumn: null, mappedSourceHash: null,
        classification: "candidate-only producer call to prepareGroupContextSource; requires closed neighbor proof" };
    throw new Error(`qualification: unavailable origin mapping ${leaf}:${line}; parent investigation required`);
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    const frame = frames[i]!;
    if (frame.kind !== "native-runtime") continue;
    const callback = frames[i - 1], caller = frames[i + 1];
    insist(callback?.kind === "product" && caller?.kind === "product", "native map requires two concrete scientific neighbors");
    frame.nativeProof = proveFiniteNativeMap(frame.raw, i,
      { file: callback.file, sourceSha256: callback.sourceHash, line: callback.line, column: callback.column },
      { file: caller.file, sourceSha256: caller.sourceHash, line: caller.line, column: caller.column }, sites, side);
  }
  return frames;
}
type ErrorOwn = Array<{ key: string; descriptor: { enumerable: boolean; configurable: boolean; writable: boolean; value: unknown } }>;
function reconcileOrigins(baseline: readonly Origin[], candidate: readonly Origin[], dispatch?: DispatchPair) {
  return reconcileOriginFrames(baseline, candidate, sourceFile, productPins.candidate["investigation-groups.ts"]!, dispatch);
}
type ErrorEnvelope = {
  error: Error; reference: 0; firstCapture: "guard" | "action"; name: string; message: string; code: string;
  after: ErrorOwn; frames: Origin[]; beforeArtifact: Artifact; afterArtifact: Artifact; nativeProofArtifact: Artifact;
  nativeProofData: { frames: Origin[]; rawStack: string; runId: string };
  nativePointVerified: true;
};
const TECHNICAL_ERROR_KEYS = ["stack", "originalLine", "originalColumn", "line", "column", "sourceURL"] as const;
function rawOwn(error: Error): ErrorOwn {
  return Reflect.ownKeys(error).map(key => {
    insist(typeof key === "string", "symbol Error property unsupported");
    const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(error, key);
    insist(d !== undefined && Object.hasOwn(d, "value") && !Object.hasOwn(d, "get") && !Object.hasOwn(d, "set"), "Error accessor unsupported");
    const value: unknown = d.value;
    return { key, descriptor: { enumerable: !!d.enumerable, configurable: !!d.configurable, writable: !!d.writable, value } };
  });
}
function captureError(error: unknown, side: Side, firstCapture: "guard" | "action", catalog: NativeCatalog, writer: Writer): ErrorEnvelope {
  try {
    insist(error instanceof Error, "not an Error");
    const before = rawOwn(error), beforeText = writer.encode(before, "ERROR");
    const beforeArtifact = writer.putEncoded("error-before", beforeText, "ERROR");
    const stack = error.stack; // FIRST explicit stack read; previous operation captured descriptor DATA.
    const after = rawOwn(error), afterText = writer.encode(after, "ERROR");
    const afterArtifact = writer.putEncoded("error-after", afterText, "ERROR");
    insist(beforeText === afterText && typeof stack === "string", "uncovered Error descriptor transition");
    const api = side === "baseline" ? B : C, diagnostic = error instanceof api.ClusterDiagnosticError;
    insist(diagnostic || Object.getPrototypeOf(error) === Error.prototype, "import/SDK/assertion/non-scientific Error prototype");
    const expectedKeys = diagnostic
      ? ["message", "diagnostic", "name", "originalLine", "originalColumn", "line", "column", "sourceURL", "stack"]
      : ["message", "originalLine", "originalColumn", "line", "column", "sourceURL", "stack"];
    insist(after.length === expectedKeys.length && after.every((entry, i) => entry.key === expectedKeys[i]
      && entry.descriptor.configurable && entry.descriptor.writable
      && entry.descriptor.enumerable === (entry.key === "diagnostic" || entry.key === "name")), "unsupported Error keys/order/flags");
    const field = (key: string): unknown => after.find(entry => entry.key === key)?.descriptor.value;
    const name = error.name, message = field("message"), sourceURL = field("sourceURL");
    insist(name === (diagnostic ? "ClusterDiagnosticError" : "Error") && typeof message === "string"
      && /^(cluster|investigation-groups): /.test(message) && field("stack") === stack && typeof sourceURL === "string", "not a scientific refusal");
    let code = "Error";
    if (diagnostic) {
      const d = field("diagnostic");
      insist(d !== null && typeof d === "object" && !Array.isArray(d), "diagnostic shape");
      const r = d as Record<string, unknown>, keys = Reflect.ownKeys(r);
      insist(["version", "code", "detail"].every(key => Object.hasOwn(r, key)) && keys.every(k => typeof k === "string" && ["version", "code", "detail", "counts"].includes(k))
        && r.version === "cluster-refusal-v1" && typeof r.code === "string" && typeof r.detail === "string", "diagnostic semantic fields");
      code = r.code;
    }
    assertMapContinuity();
    const frames = origins(stack, error, side, catalog.catalog.nativeMapSites), top = frames[0]!;
    insist(top.kind === "product" && top.rawLocation === sourceURL, "sourceURL must equal raw scientific stack top");
    for (const frame of frames) {
      if (frame.kind === "native-runtime") { insist(frame.nativeProof !== undefined, "runtime frame has no finite provenance proof"); continue; }
      insist(catalog.bySourceURL.get(frame.file)?.sourceByteRef.sha256 === frame.sourceHash, "frame outside same-run source catalogue");
    }
    const line = field("line"), column = field("column"), originalLine = field("originalLine"), originalColumn = field("originalColumn");
    insist(natural(line) && natural(column) && natural(originalLine) && natural(originalColumn) && line === top.line && column === top.column, "native source metadata/top mismatch");
    const module = catalog.bySourceURL.get(sourceURL);
    insist(module !== undefined && module.side === side && module.scriptURL === sourceURL && module.sourceByteRef.sha256 === top.sourceHash, "wrong native module/run");
    const range = nativeRange(module, originalLine, originalColumn, line, column);
    const nativeProofData = { reference: 0, firstCapture, runId: catalog.binding.runId,
      scriptId: module.scriptId, sourceByteRef: module.sourceByteRef, emittedByteRef: module.emittedByteRef, nativeSourceMapByteRef: module.nativeSourceMapByteRef,
      originalLine, originalColumn, sourceURL, line, column, range, rawStack: stack, frames };
    const nativeProofArtifact = writer.put("error-proof", nativeProofData, "ERROR");
    return { error, reference: 0, firstCapture, name, message, code, after, frames, beforeArtifact, afterArtifact, nativeProofArtifact, nativeProofData, nativePointVerified: true };
  } catch {
    if (writer.terminal) throw TERMINAL;
    return writer.fail("PROFILE", "ERROR");
  }
}
function semanticError(envelope: ErrorEnvelope, pairProof: ReturnType<typeof reconcileOrigins> | null) {
  requireTechnicalProof(envelope.nativePointVerified, pairProof);
  const own = envelope.after.map(entry => ({ key: entry.key, descriptor: { ...entry.descriptor,
    value: (TECHNICAL_ERROR_KEYS as readonly string[]).includes(entry.key)
      ? { verifiedTechnical: entry.key, errorReference: 0, fullOriginPairProof: 0 } : entry.descriptor.value } }));
  return { name: envelope.name, message: envelope.message, code: envelope.code, own };
}
function requireTechnicalProof(nativePointVerified: boolean, pairProof: ReturnType<typeof reconcileOrigins> | null): void {
  insist(nativePointVerified && pairProof !== null, "technical tags require native point AND full paired origin proof");
}

// The source-only corpus builder below returns data/closures. It is invoked only
// inside the future test body, never while loading this proposed test module.
let dispatchOwner: ReturnType<typeof createDispatchOwner> | undefined;
function numericCases(): ProposedCase[] {
  const result: ProposedCase[] = [];
  const add = (name: string, config: unknown, expected: Expected, oracle: string, make: ProposedCase["make"]): void => {
    const entry = { id: `numeric/${name}`, inputHash: sha(observe(config)), config, expected, oracle, make };
    dispatchOwner?.registerCase(entry); result.push(entry);
  };
  for (const direct of [false, true]) for (const scale of [2 ** -1000, 1, 2 ** 990]) {
    add(`roundtrip/${direct ? "direct" : "public"}/${bits(scale)}`, { direct, scale, seed: "roundtrip", tolerance: .5 * scale, pprDirections: ["callee", "caller", "both"] }, ok, "cluster.test.ts:568-586", (side, guard) => {
      const api = side === "baseline" ? B : C, codec: NumericApi = side === "candidate" && direct ? D : api;
      const arcs = [{ source: 0, target: 1, weight: scale }, { source: 0, target: 1, weight: scale * 2 ** -54 }, { source: 2, target: 3, weight: scale }];
      const ids = [id(0), id(1), id(2), id(3)];
      const graph = guard("roundtrip/sparseGraph", { ids, arcs }, () => codec.sparseGraph(ids, arcs));
      return { state: { graph, arcs }, action: () => {
        if (side === "candidate") { expect(C.sparseGraph).toBe(D.sparseGraph); expect(C.exportSparseGraph).toBe(D.exportSparseGraph); expect(C.importSparseGraph).toBe(D.importSparseGraph); }
        const snapshot = guard("roundtrip/export", graph, () => codec.exportSparseGraph(graph));
        const imported: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot));
        const restored = guard("roundtrip/import", imported, () => codec.importSparseGraph(imported));
        const reexported = guard("roundtrip/reexport", restored, () => codec.exportSparseGraph(restored));
        insist(observe(reexported) === observe(snapshot), "exact snapshot reexport roundtrip");
        const leidenConfig = { seed: "roundtrip", temperature: 0, tolerance: .5 * scale };
        const lr = guard("roundtrip/leiden", { restored, leidenConfig }, () => api.leiden(restored, leidenConfig));
        const ppr = (["callee", "caller", "both"] as const).map(direction => {
          const seeds = [id(0)], config = { direction, tolerance: 1e-11 };
          const p = guard(`roundtrip/ppr/${direction}`, { restored, seeds, config }, () => api.personalizedPageRank(restored, seeds, config));
          expect(cmp(pprOracle(4, arcs, [0], direction, .85).residual(p.scores), fromNumber(p.residualUpperBound))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0); return p;
        });
        const labels = [0, 0, 1, 1];
        return { graph, snapshot, restored, reexported, lr, ppr, modularity: guard("roundtrip/modularity", { restored, labels }, () => api.directedModularity(restored, labels)) };
      } };
    });
  }
  for (const direct of [false, true]) add(`legacy/${direct ? "direct" : "public"}`, { direct, seed: SEED }, ok, "cluster.test.ts:588-592", (side, guard) => {
    const api = side === "baseline" ? B : C, codec: NumericApi = side === "candidate" && direct ? D : api;
    const ids = [id(0), id(1)], arcs = [{ source: 0, target: 1, weight: 1 }, { source: 0, target: 1, weight: 2 ** -54 }];
    const graph = guard("legacy/sparseGraph", { ids, arcs }, () => codec.sparseGraph(ids, arcs));
    delete graph.numericPolicy; delete graph.numericSource;
    return { state: graph, action: () => {
      const exported = guard("legacy/export", graph, () => codec.exportSparseGraph(graph));
      const restored = guard("legacy/import", exported, () => codec.importSparseGraph(exported));
      insist(exported.numericPolicy.weightConvention === "canonical-arcs-v1", "legacy convention");
      const config = { seed: SEED, temperature: 0 };
      return { graph, exported, restored, leiden: guard("legacy/leiden", { graph, config }, () => api.leiden(graph, config)) };
    } };
  });
  const poison: Array<[string, (g: B.SparseGraph, side: Side) => void]> = [
    ["arc", g => { g.arcs[0]!.weight *= 2; }], ["id", g => { g.ids[0] = id(99); }],
    ["out", g => { g.out[0]!.set(1, 2); }], ["incoming", g => { g.incoming[1]!.set(0, 2); }],
    ["outDegree", g => { g.outDegree[0]!++; }], ["inDegree", g => { g.inDegree[1]!++; }],
    ["totalWeight", g => { g.totalWeight++; }], ["negativeZeroCache", g => { g.outDegree[1] = -0; }],
    ["summandWeight", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs[0]!.weight *= 2; }], ["summandEndpoint", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs[0]!.source = 99; }],
    ["summandZero", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs[0]!.weight = 0; }], ["summandNegativeZero", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs[0]!.weight = -0; }],
    ["summandInfinity", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs[0]!.weight = Infinity; }], ["summandNaN", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs[0]!.weight = NaN; }],
    ["summandOrder", g => { g.numericSource!.arcs.reverse(); }], ["rawCount", g => { g.numericSource!.rawArcCount++; }],
    ["sourceBudget", g => { g.numericSource!.maxArcs = 1; }], ["sourceVersion", g => { (g.numericSource as { version: string }).version = "unknown"; }],
    ["binding", g => { g.numericSource!.bindingFingerprint = "0".repeat(64); }], ["missingSource", g => { delete g.numericSource; }],
    ["missingPolicy", g => { delete g.numericPolicy; }], ["convention", g => { g.numericPolicy!.weightConvention = "canonical-arcs-v1"; }],
    ["rehashedStaleCaches", (g, side) => {

function groupCases(): ProposedCase[] {
  const modes = ["balanced-split", "preserve", "attach", "unknown-cost", "known-cost", "hub-cap", "empty-kernel", "capability-overflow", "context-raw", "context-affinity", "context-hub", "context-community-omission", "partial-coverage", "cost-overflow", "invalid-sizes", "empty-partition"] as const;
  return modes.map<ProposedCase>(mode => ({ id: `synthetic-groups/${mode}`, inputHash: sha(observe({ mode })), config: { mode, seed: SEED },
    expected: mode === "cost-overflow" ? { kind: "refusal", code: "Error", message: "investigation-groups: cost overflow" } : mode === "invalid-sizes" ? { kind: "refusal", code: "Error", message: "investigation-groups: minimum exceeds maximum" } : mode === "empty-partition" ? { kind: "refusal", code: "Error", message: "investigation-groups: empty snapshot/partition: no v1 partition exists; do not synthesize empty groups" } : ok,
    oracle: "cluster.test.ts:368-437; closed named variants", make: (side, guard) => {
      const api = side === "baseline" ? B : C, build = side === "baseline" ? BG : CG;
      const n = mode === "balanced-split" ? 17 : mode === "hub-cap" ? 5 : mode.startsWith("context-") || ["known-cost", "unknown-cost"].includes(mode) ? 3 : 2;
      const pairs: Array<[number, number]> = mode === "hub-cap" ? [[0, 4], [1, 4], [2, 4], [3, 4]] : mode.startsWith("context-") ? [] : Array.from({ length: n - 1 }, (_, i) => [i, i + 1]);
      const input = synthetic(n, pairs);
      const clusterConfig: B.ClusterConfig = { algorithm: mode === "balanced-split" || mode === "known-cost" || mode === "unknown-cost" ? "historical-cc" : "hub-baseline", maxCommunitySize: ["preserve", "attach"].includes(mode) ? 1 : 128, weights: mode === "hub-cap" ? { hubThreshold: 4 } : {}, leiden: { seed: SEED } };
      const cluster = guard("synthetic-groups/clusterGraph", { input, clusterConfig }, () => api.clusterGraph(input, clusterConfig));
      const partition = cluster.partition;
      const overrides = mode === "balanced-split" ? { minSize: 4, maxSize: 6 } : mode === "attach" ? { smallPolicy: "attach-adjacent" as const } : mode === "invalid-sizes" ? { minSize: 5, maxSize: 2 } : mode === "hub-cap" || mode.startsWith("context-") ? { maxContextFunctions: 1 } : {};
      if (mode === "known-cost" || mode === "unknown-cost") { partition.communities[0]!.kernelIds = [id(0), id(1)]; input.nodes[1]!.status = "quarantined"; input.nodes[1]!.semanticMaturity = "partial"; if (mode === "unknown-cost") input.nodes[0]!.instructionCount = { known: false, value: null }; }
      if (mode === "empty-kernel") partition.communities[0]!.kernelIds = [];
      if (mode === "context-community-omission") partition.communities[0]!.externalContextIds = [id(1), id(2)];
      if (mode === "capability-overflow") input.capabilities = Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `cap:${i}`, subjectId: id(0), subjectKind: "function", capability: "entry" }));
      if (mode === "partial-coverage") input.coverage = { status: "partial", uncoveredReason: "fixture partial scope" };
      if (mode === "cost-overflow") input.nodes[0]!.instructionCount = { known: true, value: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER };
      if (mode === "empty-partition") { input.nodes = []; input.edges = []; partition.communities = []; }
      const ids = input.nodes.map(n => n.id), arcs = [{ source: 0, target: 1, weight: 1 }, { source: 0, target: 2, weight: 2 }];
      const graph = mode.startsWith("context-") ? guard("synthetic-groups/sparseGraph", { ids, arcs }, () => api.sparseGraph(ids, arcs)) : cluster.projection.graph;
      const options = mode === "context-raw" ? {} : { graph, hubIds: mode === "context-hub" ? [id(2)] : cluster.metrics.hubIds };
      return { state: { input, partition, graph, options, overrides }, action: () => {
        const groups = build(input, partition, overrides, options);
        if (mode === "balanced-split") expect(groups.groups.map(g => g.ownedFunctionIds.length)).toEqual([6, 6, 5]);
        if (mode === "preserve") expect(groups.groups).toHaveLength(2);
        if (mode === "attach") expect(groups.groups).toHaveLength(1);
        if (mode === "unknown-cost") expect(groups.groups[0]!.estimatedCost).toEqual({ known: false, value: null });
        if (mode === "known-cost") expect(groups.groups[0]!.estimatedCost).toEqual({ known: true, value: 9 });
        if (mode === "empty-kernel") { expect(groups.groups).toEqual([]); expect(groups.metrics.nonCoveredIds).toEqual([id(0), id(1)]); }
        if (mode === "capability-overflow") { expect(groups.groups[0]!.capabilityIds).toHaveLength(256); expect(groups.metrics.allCapabilityIdsByGroupId[groups.groups[0]!.groupId]).toHaveLength(300); }
        if (mode.startsWith("context-")) expect(groups.groups[0]!.contextFunctionIds).toEqual(mode === "context-raw" ? [] : mode === "context-hub" ? [id(2)] : [id(1)]);
        if (mode === "context-affinity" || mode === "context-hub" || mode === "context-community-omission") expect(groups.metrics.omittedContextIdsByGroupId[groups.groups[0]!.groupId]).toEqual(mode === "context-hub" ? [id(1)] : [id(2)]);
        if (mode === "context-community-omission") expect(groups.metrics.omittedCommunityContextIds[partition.communities[0]!.contentId]).toEqual([id(2)]);
        return groups;
      } };
    } }));
}

// Existing rational oracle bodies copied (not reinvented) from the PINNED
// cluster.test.ts:460-478,486-525. No expectRounded/tolerance comparator is copied.
type R = { p: bigint; q: bigint };
const zero: R = { p: 0n, q: 1n }, one: R = { p: 1n, q: 1n };
function r(p: bigint, q = 1n): R {
  if (q < 0n) { p = -p; q = -q; }
  let a = p < 0n ? -p : p, b = q; while (b) [a, b] = [b, a % b];
  return { p: p / a, q: q / a };
}
const add = (a: R, b: R) => r(a.p * b.q + b.p * a.q, a.q * b.q);
const sub = (a: R, b: R) => r(a.p * b.q - b.p * a.q, a.q * b.q);
const mul = (a: R, b: R) => r(a.p * b.p, a.q * b.q);
const div = (a: R, b: R) => r(a.p * b.q, a.q * b.p);
const cmp = (a: R, b: R) => a.p * b.q < b.p * a.q ? -1 : a.p * b.q > b.p * a.q ? 1 : 0;
const abs = (a: R) => ({ p: a.p < 0n ? -a.p : a.p, q: a.q });
const total = (values: R[]) => values.reduce(add, zero);
function fromNumber(value: number): R {
  const [whole, fraction = ""] = Math.abs(value).toString(2).split(".");
  return r((value < 0 ? -1n : 1n) * BigInt(`0b${whole}${fraction}`), 1n << BigInt(fraction.length));
}
function matrix(n: number, arcs: B.Arc[]): R[][] {
  const a = Array.from({ length: n }, () => Array.from({ length: n }, () => zero));
  for (const e of arcs) a[e.source]![e.target] = add(a[e.source]![e.target]!, fromNumber(e.weight));
  return a;
}
function qOracle(n: number, arcs: B.Arc[], labels: number[], gamma = 1): R {
  const a = matrix(n, arcs), m = total(a.flat()); if (!m.p) return zero;
  const normalized = a.map(row => row.map(x => div(x, m))), rows = normalized.map(total), columns = a.map((_, j) => total(normalized.map(row => row[j]!)));
  let answer = zero;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) if (labels[i] === labels[j]) answer = add(answer, sub(normalized[i]![j]!, mul(fromNumber(gamma), mul(rows[i]!, columns[j]!))));
  return answer;
}
function movesOracle(n: number, arcs: B.Arc[], labels: number[], tolerance: number, gamma = 1) {
  const q = qOracle(n, arcs, labels, gamma), threshold = div(fromNumber(tolerance), total(matrix(n, arcs).flat()));
  let max = zero, improving = 0;
  for (let node = 0; node < n; node++) {
    let best = zero;
    for (const target of [...new Set(labels), Math.max(...labels) + 1]) {
      const changed = labels.slice(); changed[node] = target;
      const gain = sub(qOracle(n, arcs, changed, gamma), q); if (cmp(gain, best) > 0) best = gain;
    }
    if (cmp(best, threshold) > 0) improving++;
    if (cmp(best, max) > 0) max = best;
  }
  return { max, improving, threshold };
}
function pprOracle(n: number, arcs: B.Arc[], seeds: number[], direction: "callee" | "caller" | "both", damping: number) {
  const directed = direction === "callee" ? arcs : direction === "caller" ? arcs.map(e => ({ ...e, source: e.target, target: e.source })) : arcs.flatMap(e => [e, { ...e, source: e.target, target: e.source }]);
  const a = matrix(n, directed), rows = a.map(total), p = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => seeds.includes(i) ? r(1n, BigInt(seeds.length)) : zero), d = fromNumber(damping);
  const transition = a.map((row, i) => rows[i]!.p ? row.map(w => div(w, rows[i]!)) : p);
  const b = p.map(v => mul(sub(one, d), v));
  const system = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, target) => [...Array.from({ length: n }, (_, source) => sub(source === target ? one : zero, mul(d, transition[source]![target]!))), b[target]!]);
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const pivot = system.findIndex((row, i) => i >= k && row[k]!.p !== 0n); expect(pivot).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(k);
    [system[k], system[pivot]] = [system[pivot]!, system[k]!];
    const divisor = system[k]![k]!; system[k] = system[k]!.map(x => div(x, divisor));
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (i !== k) { const factor = system[i]![k]!; system[i] = system[i]!.map((x, j) => sub(x, mul(factor, system[k]![j]!))); }
  }
  return { solution: system.map(row => row[n]!), residual: (scores: number[]) => total(b.map((v, j) => abs(sub(add(v, total(transition.map((row, i) => mul(d, mul(row[j]!, fromNumber(scores[i]!)))))), fromNumber(scores[j]!))))) };
}

// Pure infrastructure/shape counterexamples, not new scientific pair cases.
function sourceControls(catalog: NativeCatalog): void {
  insist(observe(0) !== observe(-0) && observe({ x: undefined }) !== observe({}), "observer scalar/absence control");
  insist(observe(new Map([["a", 1], ["b", 2]])) !== observe(new Map([["b", 2], ["a", 1]])), "Map order control");
  const alias = {}; insist(observe([alias, alias]) !== observe([{}, {}]) && observe(new Array<undefined>(1)) !== observe([undefined]), "alias/hole control");
  const descriptor = (value: unknown) => ({ enumerable: false, configurable: true, writable: true, value });
  const shape: ErrorOwn = [{ key: "message", descriptor: descriptor("synthetic") }, { key: "stack", descriptor: descriptor("synthetic stack") }];
  const shapeOnly = (rows: ErrorOwn) => observe(rows.map(row => ({ key: row.key, enumerable: row.descriptor.enumerable,
    configurable: row.descriptor.configurable, writable: row.descriptor.writable, valueType: typeof row.descriptor.value })));
  for (const flag of ["enumerable", "configurable", "writable"] as const) {
    const bad = structuredClone(shape); bad[1]!.descriptor[flag] = !bad[1]!.descriptor[flag]; insist(shapeOnly(bad) !== shapeOnly(shape), "descriptor flag control");
  }
  insist(shapeOnly([shape[1]!, shape[0]!]) !== shapeOnly(shape) && shapeOnly([shape[0]!]) !== shapeOnly(shape), "descriptor order/presence control");
  expect(() => requireTechnicalProof(false, null)).toThrow(); expect(() => requireTechnicalProof(true, null)).toThrow();
  for (const markerFails of [false, true]) {
    const files = new Map<string, string>();
    const io: EvidenceIO = { read: path => { const text = files.get(path); if (text === undefined) throw TERMINAL; return text; },
      write: (path, text) => { if (path.includes("-1-stage")) { files.set(path, text.slice(0, 3)); throw TERMINAL; }
        if (markerFails && path.endsWith("FATAL.json")) { files.set(path, "{"); throw TERMINAL; } files.set(path, text); } };
    const totals: Record<Side, number> = { baseline: 0, candidate: 0 }, w = evidenceWriter("memory-controls", "baseline", 0, totals, io);
    const good = w.put("stage", { complete: true }, "STAGE");
    try { w.put("stage", { rejectedPartial: true }, "STAGE"); } catch { /* terminal signal only */ }
    insist(w.terminal && w.acceptedCount === 1 && files.get(good.path) === good.text
      && w.markerDurability === (markerFails ? "unknown" : "written"), "partial write/marker durability control");
  }
  {
    const files = new Map<string, string>(), totals: Record<Side, number> = { baseline: 0, candidate: 0 };
    const w = evidenceWriter("memory-cap-control", "baseline", 0, totals, { write: (p, t) => { files.set(p, t); }, read: p => files.get(p) ?? "" });
    const good = w.put("stage", { acceptedPrefix: true }, "STAGE"); let visits = 0;
    const rejected = new Proxy({ huge: "x".repeat(LIMIT) }, { ownKeys(target) { visits++; return Reflect.ownKeys(target); } });
    try { w.put("stage", rejected, "STAGE"); } catch { /* no failed-payload formatting */ }
    try { w.put("index", rejected, "PAIR"); } catch { /* terminal must prevent re-observation */ }
    insist(visits === 1 && w.terminal && w.acceptedCount === 1 && files.get(good.path) === good.text
      && w.markerDurability === "written" && [...files].filter(([p]) => p.endsWith("FATAL.json")).every(([, t]) => Buffer.byteLength(t) < RESERVE), "oversize terminal/no-reobserve control");
  }
  for (const branchCap of [false, true]) {
    const files = new Map<string, string>(), totals: Record<Side, number> = { baseline: branchCap ? BRANCH_LIMIT - RESERVE : 0, candidate: 0 };
    const w = evidenceWriter("memory-accumulation-control", "baseline", 0, totals, { write: (p, t) => { files.set(p, t); }, read: p => files.get(p) ?? "" });
    let acceptedPrefix: Artifact | undefined;
    try { if (!branchCap) acceptedPrefix = w.put("stage", "x".repeat(LIMIT / 2), "STAGE"); w.put("stage", "y".repeat(LIMIT / 2), "STAGE"); } catch { /* fixed terminal */ }
    insist(w.terminal && w.markerDurability === "written" && w.acceptedCount === (branchCap ? 0 : 1)
      && (acceptedPrefix === undefined || files.get(acceptedPrefix.path) === acceptedPrefix.text), "cumulative case/branch cap keeps admitted prefix");
  }
  const own = catalog.bySourceURL.get(resolve(import.meta.path)); insist(own !== undefined, "shared test catalogue control");
  const syntheticOrigin: Origin = { raw: "synthetic chain control, not a runtime frame", rawLocation: own.scriptURL,
    file: own.scriptURL, line: 1, column: 1, sourceHash: own.sourceByteRef.sha256, sourceLine: own.sourceLines[0]!, kind: "test",
    classification: "synthetic control only", mappedFile: own.scriptURL, mappedLine: 1, mappedColumn: 1, mappedSourceHash: own.sourceByteRef.sha256 };
  expect(() => reconcileOrigins([syntheticOrigin], [syntheticOrigin, { ...syntheticOrigin, line: 2, mappedLine: 2 }])).toThrow();
  for (const column of [19, 186, 187]) insist(!(column >= 20 && column <= 185), "closed wrapper column control");
  {
    const old = catalog.bySourceURL.get(sourceFile("baseline", "investigation-groups.ts"))!;
    const leaf = catalog.bySourceURL.get(sourceFile("candidate", "group-context-codecs.ts"))!;
    const producer = catalog.bySourceURL.get(sourceFile("candidate", "investigation-groups.ts"))!;
    const callerIndex = own.sourceLines.findIndex(line => line.trimStart().startsWith("const groups = build("));
    insist(callerIndex >= 0, "reviewed test caller control");
    const caller: Origin = { ...syntheticOrigin, line: callerIndex + 1, mappedLine: callerIndex + 1, sourceLine: own.sourceLines[callerIndex]!,
      column: own.sourceLines[callerIndex]!.indexOf("build(") + 1, mappedColumn: own.sourceLines[callerIndex]!.indexOf("build(") + 1 };
    const previousB: Origin = { ...syntheticOrigin, file: old.scriptURL, rawLocation: old.scriptURL, line: 60, column: 3, sourceLine: old.sourceLines[59]!,
      sourceHash: old.sourceByteRef.sha256, kind: "product", mappedFile: old.scriptURL, mappedLine: 60, mappedColumn: 3, mappedSourceHash: old.sourceByteRef.sha256 };
    const previousC: Origin = { ...previousB, file: leaf.scriptURL, rawLocation: leaf.scriptURL, line: 67, sourceLine: leaf.sourceLines[66]!, sourceHash: leaf.sourceByteRef.sha256 };
    const wrapper: Origin = { ...previousC, file: producer.scriptURL, rawLocation: producer.scriptURL, line: 49, sourceLine: producer.sourceLines[48]!,
      sourceHash: producer.sourceByteRef.sha256, kind: "prepare-wrapper", mappedFile: null, mappedLine: null, mappedColumn: null, mappedSourceHash: null };
    for (const column of [19, 186, 187]) expect(() => reconcileOrigins([previousB, caller], [previousC, { ...wrapper, column }, caller])).toThrow();
    for (const column of [20, 185]) insist(reconcileOrigins([previousB, caller], [previousC, { ...wrapper, column }, caller]).consumedCandidate.length === 3, "inclusive wrapper endpoints control");
  }
  expect(() => closed({ version: "unknown", extra: true }, ["version"])).toThrow();
  expect(() => catalogueVersion("unknown")).toThrow();
  expect(() => invocationInputs(undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined)).toThrow();
  insist(!equalRef(own.emittedByteRef, { ...own.emittedByteRef, sha256: "0".repeat(64) })
    && !equalRef(own.nativeSourceMapByteRef, { ...own.nativeSourceMapByteRef, sha256: "0".repeat(64) }), "emit/map pin control");
  insist(catalog.bySourceURL.get("unapproved-source") === undefined, "foreign/unknown module control");
  for (const module of catalog.bySourceURL.values()) {
    const row = module.pointRanges[0]!;
    expect(() => nativeRange(module, 0, 0, row.sourceLine, row.sourceColumn)).toThrow();
    expect(() => nativeRange(module, row.generatedLine, row.firstColumn, row.sourceLine, row.sourceColumn + 1)).toThrow();
  }
  const modules = [...catalog.bySourceURL.values()], selected = modules[0]!, other = modules[1]!;
  const sourceText = catalog.cachedBytes(selected.sourceByteRef).toString("utf8"), emitText = catalog.cachedBytes(selected.emittedByteRef).toString("utf8"), mapBytes = catalog.cachedBytes(selected.nativeSourceMapByteRef);
  expect(() => nativeInlineProof(sourceText, emitText, Buffer.from("{}"), selected.nativeMapSource, selected.scriptURL)).toThrow();
  expect(() => nativeInlineProof(sourceText, emitText.replace("//# sourceURL=", "//# sourceURL=wrong-"), mapBytes, selected.nativeMapSource, selected.scriptURL)).toThrow();
  expect(() => nativeInlineProof(catalog.cachedBytes(other.sourceByteRef).toString("utf8"), emitText, mapBytes, selected.nativeMapSource, selected.scriptURL)).toThrow();
  expect(() => catalog.cachedBytes({ ...selected.sourceByteRef, sha256: "0".repeat(64) })).toThrow();
  {
    const files = new Map<string, string>(), totals: Record<Side, number> = { baseline: 0, candidate: 0 };
    const w = evidenceWriter("memory-unverified-error", "baseline", 0, totals, { write: (p, t) => { files.set(p, t); }, read: p => files.get(p) ?? "" });
    let rejected = false;
    try { captureError(new Error("cluster: synthetic unverified interception"), "baseline", "action", catalog, w); } catch { rejected = true; }
    insist(rejected && w.terminal, "authored dummy/native profile must not become a scientific refusal");
  }
}

test("FULL bounded numeric/context differential (source proposal; parent gates required)", async () => {
  const supplied = process.env.PARENT_NUMERIC_EVIDENCE_DIR;
  insist(supplied !== undefined && isAbsolute(supplied) && /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(supplied), "parent must supply an existing local absolute OWN run-layout root");
  const root = join(supplied, "numeric-context-qualification-v3");
  mkdirSync(root); // Fresh exclusive CASE child, distinct from parent's provenance namespace.
  const totals: Record<Side, number> = { baseline: 0, candidate: 0 };
  const io: EvidenceIO = { write: (path, text) => writeFileSync(path, text, { flag: "wx" }), read: path => {
    const stat = lstatSync(path); insist(stat.isFile() && stat.size <= LIMIT, "case artifact read cap"); return decodeEvidenceBytes(readFileSync(path)); } };
  const setup = evidenceWriter(root, "baseline", -1, totals, io);
  let catalog: NativeCatalog;
  try { catalog = await nativeCatalog(supplied); sourceControls(catalog); }
  catch { return setup.fail("CATALOG", "CATALOG"); }
  // Nothing above invokes make, projection, clustering or another scientific API.
  dispatchOwner = createDispatchOwner(catalog.dispatchAuthority);
  const cases = [...matrixCases(), ...numericCases(), ...groupCases()];
  insist(new Set(cases.map(c => c.id)).size === cases.length && cases.length === 450
    && cases.filter(c => c.expected.kind === "value").length === 224 && cases.filter(c => c.expected.kind === "refusal").length === 226, "unchanged case ledger");
  type Branch = { writer: Writer; state: unknown; value: unknown; envelope: ErrorEnvelope | undefined;
    stages: Array<{ proof: StageProof; artifact: Artifact }>; indexArtifact: Artifact; dispatchToken?: object };
  for (let index = 0; index < cases.length; index++) {
    const c = cases[index]!, branches: Partial<Record<Side, Branch>> = {};
    const dispatchIteration = dispatchOwner.begin(c, index);
    for (const side of ["baseline", "candidate"] as const) {
      const w = evidenceWriter(root, side, index, totals, io), stages: Branch["stages"] = [];
      let envelope: ErrorEnvelope | undefined;
      const latestEnvelope = (): ErrorEnvelope | undefined => envelope;
      const capture = (error: unknown, phase: "guard" | "action"): ErrorEnvelope => {
        if (w.terminal) throw TERMINAL;
        if (envelope !== undefined) { if (error !== envelope.error) return w.fail("PROFILE", "ERROR"); return envelope; }
        envelope = captureError(error, side, phase, catalog, w); return envelope;
      };
      const guard: Guard = <T>(label: string, inputs: unknown, call: () => T): T => {
        if (w.terminal) throw TERMINAL;
        if (stages.length >= MAX_STAGES) return w.fail("STAGE_LIMIT", "STAGE");
        const refs: object[] = [], before = w.encode(inputs, "STAGE", refs); let returned = false, errorReference: 0 | null = null;
        try { const value = call(); returned = true; return value; }
        catch (error) { if (w.terminal) throw TERMINAL; capture(error, "guard"); errorReference = 0; throw error; }
        finally {
          if (!w.terminal) {
            const afterRefs: object[] = [], after = w.encode(inputs, "STAGE", afterRefs);
            const referencesStable = refs.length === afterRefs.length && refs.every((ref, i) => ref === afterRefs[i]);
            const proof = { label, before, after, referenceCount: refs.length, referencesStable, returned, errorReference };
            const artifact = w.put("stage", proof, "STAGE"); stages.push({ proof, artifact });
            if (before !== after || !referencesStable) w.fail("MUTATION", "STAGE");
          }
        }
      };
      try {
        // A make/preparation failure is fatal, never a substituted scientific refusal.
        const work = c.make(side, guard), refs: object[] = [], before = w.encode(work.state, "ACTION", refs);
        const finishDispatch = dispatchIteration?.bind(side, work, sha(before));
        let value: unknown, failed = false;
        try { value = work.action(); }
        catch (error) { if (w.terminal) throw TERMINAL; capture(error, "action"); failed = true; }
        const afterRefs: object[] = [], after = w.encode(work.state, "ACTION", afterRefs);
        if (before !== after || refs.length !== afterRefs.length || !refs.every((ref, i) => ref === afterRefs[i])) w.fail("MUTATION", "ACTION");
        if (failed) {
          const captured = latestEnvelope();
          if (c.expected.kind !== "refusal" || captured === undefined || captured.code !== c.expected.code
            || c.expected.message !== undefined && captured.message !== c.expected.message) w.fail("QUALIFICATION", "ERROR");
        } else if (c.expected.kind !== "value" || latestEnvelope() !== undefined) w.fail("QUALIFICATION", "ACTION");
        const indexData = { id: c.id, inputHash: sha(before), sourceFixtureOrCaseSpecHash: c.inputHash,
          config: c.config, expected: c.expected, oracle: c.oracle, stageCount: stages.length,
          stages: stages.map(stage => ({ ordinal: stage.artifact.ordinal, label: stage.proof.label, errorReference: stage.proof.errorReference })) };
        const indexArtifact = w.put("index", indexData, "ACTION");
        const dispatchCapture = latestEnvelope();
        const dispatchToken = finishDispatch?.(indexArtifact, indexData, w.read(indexArtifact), {
          frames: dispatchCapture!.frames, rawStack: dispatchCapture!.after.find(entry => entry.key === "stack")!.descriptor.value as string,
          runId: catalog.binding.runId, artifact: dispatchCapture!.nativeProofArtifact, text: w.read(dispatchCapture!.nativeProofArtifact), data: dispatchCapture!.nativeProofData });
        branches[side] = { writer: w, state: work.state, value, envelope: latestEnvelope(), stages, indexArtifact, dispatchToken };
      } catch { if (w.terminal) throw TERMINAL; w.fail("QUALIFICATION", "MAKE"); }
    }
    const b = branches.baseline, candidate = branches.candidate;
    insist(b !== undefined && candidate !== undefined, "missing branch result");
    let pairProof: ReturnType<typeof reconcileOrigins> | null = null;
    try {
      if (c.expected.kind === "refusal") {
        insist(b.envelope !== undefined && candidate.envelope !== undefined, "missing native Error envelopes");
        const dispatch = dispatchIteration === undefined ? undefined : dispatchIteration.pair(b.dispatchToken!, candidate.dispatchToken!);
        pairProof = reconcileOrigins(b.envelope.frames, candidate.envelope.frames, dispatch);
      }
    } catch { return b.writer.fail("ORIGIN", "PAIR"); }
    // Technical tags can be constructed ONLY now: same-run native tuples proved
    // locally and the entire two-sided source chain has consumed every frame.
    const bError = b.envelope === undefined ? null : semanticError(b.envelope, pairProof);
    const cError = candidate.envelope === undefined ? null : semanticError(candidate.envelope, pairProof);
    if (b.stages.length !== candidate.stages.length || b.writer.read(b.indexArtifact) !== candidate.writer.read(candidate.indexArtifact)) b.writer.fail("MISMATCH", "PAIR");
    for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < b.stages.length; ordinal++) {
      const bs = b.stages[ordinal]!, cs = candidate.stages[ordinal]!;
      if (b.writer.read(bs.artifact) !== candidate.writer.read(cs.artifact)) b.writer.fail("MISMATCH", "PAIR");
      // Full error-semantic augmentation, not a raw-path/digest equality claim.
      const bView = b.writer.encode({ stage: bs.proof, error: bs.proof.errorReference === null ? null : bError }, "PAIR");
      const cView = candidate.writer.encode({ stage: cs.proof, error: cs.proof.errorReference === null ? null : cError }, "PAIR");
      if (bView !== cView) b.writer.fail("MISMATCH", "PAIR");
    }
    const bObservation = b.writer.put("observation", { id: c.id, kind: c.expected.kind, state: b.state, value: b.value, error: bError }, "PAIR");
    const cObservation = candidate.writer.put("observation", { id: c.id, kind: c.expected.kind, state: candidate.state, value: candidate.value, error: cError }, "PAIR");
    if (b.writer.read(bObservation) !== candidate.writer.read(cObservation)) b.writer.fail("MISMATCH", "PAIR");
    for (const [branch, error] of [[b, bError], [candidate, cError]] as const) {
      if (error !== null) branch.writer.put("error-semantic", error, "PAIR");
      branch.writer.put("pair", { id: c.id, expected: c.expected, sourceFixtureOrCaseSpecHash: c.inputHash,
        nativeRunId: catalog.binding.runId, fullObservationEqual: true, fullStageCount: branch.stages.length,
        originChainProof: pairProof, chargedCaseBytesBeforePair: branch.writer.charged }, "PAIR");
    }
  }
  for (const side of ["baseline", "candidate"] as const) {
    evidenceWriter(root, side, 450, totals, io).put("complete", { proposedPairs: 450, observedPairs: 450,
      valuePairs: 224, refusalPairs: 226, branchBytesBeforeCompletion: { ...totals }, nativeRunId: catalog.binding.runId,
      qualifiedNativeOrFull44: false }, "COMPLETE");
  }
}, 120000);
